subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】UK 英国; Canada 加拿大; USA 美国; China 中国; she 她; he 他; student 学生; pupil 小学生; teacher 教师
【重点句型】Where are you from? 你来自哪里？ I'm from ... 我来自…… We have a new friend today. 今天我们有一个新朋友。 He's a ... 他是一名…… This is ... 这是……
【A Let's talk】Amy: Mr Jones, this is Amy. She's a new student. Mr Jones: Where are you from? Amy: I'm from the UK. Mr Jones: Welcome!
【Read and write】We have two new friends today. Hi, I'm Amy. I'm from the UK. Hi, I'm Zhang Peng. I'm from China. We are friends. We like to play.
key_points: Where are you from? 你来自哪里？
We have a new friend today. 今天我们有一个新朋友。
